Emits data-pc-fit-nav + (keen) a hook+generated id. svelte `collapse`, keen `collapse`. CAPABILITY-ONLY — not strict-compared (keen's generated id can't reconcile with svelte's id-free SSR).

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css (grep '\.pc-navmenu(--|__)'). The `.pc-navmenu` BLOCK has ZERO modifiers (rc14 dropped `--start`/`--end`; no `.pc-navmenu--*` in main.css). `collapse` is a shared capability but produces an ATTRIBUTE (data-pc-fit-nav), not a class → `produces: null` (declared for axis-2 completeness; both maps must list the menu/sidebar options). All element classes (__item*/__link/__dropdown*) come from slot-fed nav_item/nav_dropdown sub-components → deferred; the __more*/__item--more machinery is fit.js-built at runtime → cssStateElements. So the container contract is: the base class + an items slot + the collapse capability + a class passthrough.

items.note: the menu's list items (slot-fed sub-components in a real app); svelte `children`, keen `inner_block`. Structural — the container wraps them in <ul>.

collapse.note: responsive-collapse mode → data-pc-fit-nav ATTRIBUTE (not a class). svelte `collapse`, keen `collapse`. Capability-only — not strict-compared (keen's generated hook id can't reconcile). Declared in both maps for axis-2.

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim to the root pc-navmenu nav; svelte `class`, keen `class`.

cssStateElements.//: The responsive-collapse "More" machinery is BUILT BY fit.js at runtime (appended to the nav + a detached panel parented to <body>), never present in the SSR markup either wrapper emits — so no feature can produce it and no SSR golden can exercise it. Listed here to mark it legitimately out of the strict-compare surface (see snippets/layout.html 'Generated DOM (menu mode)').
cssStateElements.pc-navmenu__item--more: the generated "More" trigger <li> fit.js appends to the nav when items fold (carries .is-open while its panel shows). Runtime-built, not SSR.
cssStateElements.pc-navmenu__more-chevron: the ›/▾ glyph inside the generated More trigger; rotates under .is-open. Runtime-built, not SSR.
cssStateElements.pc-navmenu__more-menu: the folded-items panel (a __dropdown parented to <body> to escape the navbar overflow). Runtime-built, not SSR.
cssStateElements.pc-navmenu__more-menu--open: reveals the generated panel (compound selector beating the base __dropdown display:none). Runtime-toggled, not SSR.

deferred.//: The remaining `pc-navmenu__*` element classes are emitted by SEPARATE slot-fed sub-components (nav_item → __item--active/__item--has-dropdown/__link; nav_dropdown → __dropdown/__dropdown--level2), not the pc-navmenu container shell. Acknowledged as PROSE (nav_item is its own future slice; __dropdown* are covered by nav-dropdown.json).
deferred.pc-navmenu__item--active: active-item modifier on a <li>; emitted by nav_item (is_active) — its own future slice.
deferred.pc-navmenu__item--has-dropdown: dropdown-parent modifier (brings the base pc-navmenu__item); emitted by nav_item (has_dropdown) — its own future slice.
deferred.pc-navmenu__link: optional anchor class (flex+gap for icon+text); emitted by nav_item when has_dropdown — its own future slice.
deferred.pc-navmenu__dropdown: the hover-dropdown <ul>; emitted by nav_dropdown — covered by nav-dropdown.json.
deferred.pc-navmenu__dropdown--level2: nested-dropdown modifier; emitted by nav_dropdown (is_level2) — covered by nav-dropdown.json.
